Alron Caterers made our wedding truly unforgettable. Everything was absolutely perfect,  from the breathtaking decor to the incredibly delicious food. The entire setup felt grand, luxurious, and thoughtfully curated.

A special mention to Mr. Alwyn, the owner of Alron Caterers. From the very first day of booking, he was an incredible support. He guided us patiently, was always helpful, and gave us the confidence to stay relaxed throughout the entire process. Thanks to him and his team, everything went smoothly and stress-free.

Our wedding turned out more beautiful and grand than we had imagined. We are extremely grateful to Alron Caterers and highly recommend them to anyone looking for elegance, quality, and excellence for their special occasions.

With Love,
Alen Vas

featured_reviews.name: Joelson Mathews
featured_reviews.review_text:
The best wedding caterers ever !!!!

Alwyn and his team did a wonderful job in not just the catering but also the entire wedding planning. Every detail was planned minutely & the execution was done seamlessly. Our guests mentioned that this was the best wedding they have been to. We enjoyed our wedding to the fullest.

Below are the highlights.
1. Decoration : The best decoration & lighting available in the market. Most of my friends have set this as their background in display pictures. The wedding car was also decorated in this package. Please opt for the selfie boot in the decoration, as the pictures there were amazing.
2. Food : The tastiest food out there. Adverse food variation & high quality. And best of all everything was done with extreme hygiene. Alron also helped us with a live bbq counter as per our requirements which was awesome.
3. DJ : The DJ Domnic was arranged by Alron. Domics work was very professional. We spoke multiple times to set up the right tracks to be played. The execution was done perfectly. We loved the music at the wedding.
4. Permission : All the permission were handled by Alron seamlessly. We had no issues whatsoever.
5. Attitude of the Staff : Firstly Alwyn is the best person I have ever dealt with. He made us feel like a family member. The entire staff at Alron was very polite and our guests were very pleased.

On the whole, Alrons services exceeded our expectations which was already very high. I would recommend everyone in and around Mumbai to have their wedding organized by Alron caterers.
